cases.purpose: Exercise live and dangling links within recursion and explicit links to a file and directory; read every real entry and outside target after add/remove with independent lsattr.
cases.oracle: e2fsprogs 1.47.2 chattr and lsattr on disposable ext4
cases.comparison: Byte parity of invocation statuses, diagnostics and independent per-entry flag readback. Setup and flag support must succeed.
cases.script:
set -u
I=/tmp/chattr-link-fixture.img M=/tmp/chattr-link-fixture-mnt
cleanup() { cd /tmp/parity-case; /usr/bin/umount "$M" 2>/dev/null || :; /usr/bin/rm -f "$I"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
/usr/bin/truncate -s 4M "$I" && /usr/sbin/mkfs.ext4 -q -F -O ^has_journal "$I" && /usr/bin/mkdir "$M" && /usr/bin/mount -o loop "$I" "$M" || { echo SETUP-FAILED; exit 99; }
cd "$M" || exit 99
/usr/bin/mkdir -p tree/sub external/dir || exit 99
printf x > tree/sub/file; printf x > external/file; printf x > external/dir/file
/usr/bin/chattr +d external/file || { echo PREREQUISITE-FAILED; exit 99; }
/usr/bin/lsattr -d external/file | /usr/bin/grep -q -- 'd' || { echo PREREQUISITE-FAILED; exit 99; }
/usr/bin/ln -s ../external/file tree/live
/usr/bin/ln -s ../../missing tree/sub/dangling
/usr/bin/ln -s external/dir dirlink
/usr/bin/ln -s external/file filelink
r() { local label=$1; shift; "$@" >/tmp/chattr-link-out 2>/tmp/chattr-link-err; local rc=$?; printf '%s status=%s out=' "$label" "$rc"; /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|' </tmp/chattr-link-out; printf ' err='; /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' /tmp/chattr-link-err | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'; echo; }
readback() { for f in tree tree/sub tree/sub/file external/file external/dir external/dir/file; do /usr/bin/lsattr -d "$f" || return 99; done; }
r recurse-add chattr -R +d tree
readback || exit 99
r recurse-remove chattr -R -d tree
readback || exit 99
r explicit-file-link chattr +A filelink
r explicit-dir-link chattr -R +A dirlink
readback || exit 99
